name: Krea 2 Turbo
format: ComfyUI API-format prompt graph: {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}. POST it as the `prompt` field of POST /prompt.
model: Krea 2 Turbo (Krea), ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/Krea-2 (fp8 scaled weights, fp8 Qwen3-VL 4B text encoder, Qwen-Image VAE)

licence.name: Krea 2 Community License (outputs owned by the person; revocable, content-filtering and acceptable-use terms)

source: The graph that painted the website example rooftops-spring on the user's Mac (.scratch/examples/graphs/rooftops-spring.request.json), with placeholders and without its ConditioningKrea2Rebalance node (a third-party custom node, Rebalance-Pack): the KSampler's positive is the CLIPTextEncode itself, as in Comfy-Org's template image_krea2_turbo_t2i (8 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple). Compared on 2026-10-06 at 768x432, seed 1001: with a prompt written the way AutoPaper's composer writes them (medium first, full-bleed, no 'wallpaper'), the stock graph followed the watercolour style as well as the rebalanced one.
notes: There is no negative prompt: the negative conditioning is ConditioningZeroOut of the positive (cfg 1.0), as in the official template.
Don't open the prompt with 'Desktop wallpaper': Krea 2 Turbo then paints a desktop screenshot (icons, a menu bar). AutoPaper's composer describes a full-bleed scene instead.
The CLIPLoader type 'krea2' needs a recent ComfyUI: AutoPaper offers this model only when the server lists that type.

Width and height must be multiples of 16. AutoPaper asks for at most 2048 a side and 2,965,760 pixels: the Qwen-Image VAE is 8x, and on Apple silicon VAEDecode fails past that (core/src/providers/comfyui.rs MODEL_LIMITS).
filename_prefix 'autopaper/wallpaper' makes ComfyUI write into output/autopaper/.

measured_seconds.2032x1312: 140 through the engine, M5 Max, 2026-10-06 (15.2-15.8 s a step)
